text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen—the stage for 
the showdown between the strongest 
sisters—has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How long had it been since they last stood 
side by side in a race? Even while 
acknowledging her younger sister's 
strength, Biwa Hayahide proudly declares 
her own victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day I defeat my younger 
sister as her elder sister. The showdown 
against the "Monster," Narita Brian, 
begins!
